top_signals.title: AMD sinks 5% despite earnings beat, strong data center revenue
top_signals.summary: The chip giant has been a big beneficiary of the AI boom, with stock trading 132% up so far in 2026.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Disney's Third-Quarter Profit Growth Driven by Parks, Streaming
top_signals.summary: Walt Disney Co.’s fiscal third quarter profit beat Wall Street estimates as soaring income from its entertainment division and the resilience of its theme parks in California and Florida delivered a second straight quarter of better-than-expected profitability for Chief Executive Officer Josh D’Amaro. Geetha Ranganathan of Bloomberg Intelligence has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
